name: Compute ECG artifact SSP projectors
summary: Compute SSP (signal-space projection) vectors for ECG artifacts.
description: Runs mne.preprocessing.compute_proj_ecg on continuous MEG/EEG: detects heartbeats from an ECG channel (or a substitute channel given by ch_name), epochs around them and computes SSP vectors per sensor type. Also saves projector topomaps, ECG-evoked plots and an HTML report. Apply the projectors to remove cardiac artifacts.

outputs.description: SSP projector computed based on ECG.
Topomap of the ECG projectors and ECG-evoked joint plots (PNG).

Can be ‘separate’ (default) or ‘combined’ to compute projectors for magnetometers and gradiometers separately or jointly. If ‘combined’, n_mag == n_grad is required and the number of projectors computed for MEG will be n_mag.
Dictionary of parameters to use for IIR filtering. See mne.filter.construct_iir_filter for details. If iir_params is None and method=”iir”, 4th order Butterworth will be used.
